boundaries: Frozen normative/decision digest mismatch requires explicit design revision; historical code drift is recorded and reviewed, not treated as universal failure.
Existing modules are potential reuse points, not proof that new TL operations or schema-4 tables exist.
Acceptance IDs are future test obligations. IM01 static checks do not mark them passed or replace Q11 material/labels.
No production instance, database, model, or service was opened. No frozen specification or task state was edited.
